selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Treat individually approved page-level UI/UX candidates as the authority when consolidating stage artifacts; use their provider-truth restrictions to refine broader illustrative controls from rough wireframes.

selections.heading: Forbidden
selections.text: Do not reproduce generic template controls for search, sort, pagination, correction, publication, or cross-links when approved requirements and executable provider contracts do not support them.

selections.heading: Corrections
